answer.room: an empty, bright living room with a full-width black-framed sliding glass door to a balcony, white walls, white baseboards and a warm mid-tone oak plank floor, a blank minimal canvas ready for a Nordic look

pieces.piece: a sofa against the long right-hand wall with the outlets, facing the room
pieces.why: the long blank right wall is the natural anchor for seating, and a light oatmeal fabric sofa on slim oak legs brings the soft, warm Nordic feel without blocking the light from the balcony
pieces.query:
Type: sofa, three-seater fabric sofa
Use: everyday lounging and conversation; living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: textured boucle or wool-blend fabric, solid oak legs
Colors: oatmeal, warm cream, light beige
Shape: low, clean lines, soft rounded cushions, slim tapered wooden legs, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, calm, inviting
Goes with: white walls, warm oak plank floor, black window frames; bright Nordic living room

pieces.piece: a reading armchair angled near the balcony door, on the left side by the window light
pieces.why: placing it by the big glass door gives the best natural light for reading, and an oak-framed armchair with a warm cognac or wool seat adds a cozy accent that echoes the floor
pieces.query:
Type: armchair, lounge reading chair
Use: reading by the window; living room
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern
Materials: solid oak frame, wool fabric or cognac leather cushions
Colors: natural oak, warm caramel or soft grey-beige
Shape: exposed wooden frame, slightly reclined back, armrests, comfortable cushioned seat, light visual weight
Feel: warm, relaxed, crafted
Goes with: warm oak floor, white walls, black window frames, oatmeal sofa; Nordic living room

pieces.piece: a coffee table in front of the sofa, centered on the rug
pieces.why: a low round oak coffee table keeps circulation soft in front of the sofa and repeats the warm wood of the floor in a lighter, Nordic tone
pieces.query:
Type: coffee table, low round wooden table
Use: books, cups and decor in front of the sofa; living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: solid light oak wood
Colors: natural light oak
Shape: round or soft oval top, sturdy simple legs, low, light visual weight
Feel: warm, simple, natural
Goes with: oak plank floor, oatmeal sofa, white walls; Nordic living room

pieces.piece: a large rug under the sofa front legs, coffee table and armchair
pieces.why: a textured cream wool rug softens the long wooden floor and visually ties the seating group into one warm, cozy zone
pieces.query:
Type: rug, large textured area rug
Use: defining and warming the seating area; living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: wool, natural fibers, low pile
Colors: ivory, cream, soft beige with subtle pattern
Shape: rectangular, large, subtle woven texture or soft geometric pattern
Feel: soft, warm, cozy
Goes with: warm oak floor, white walls, oatmeal sofa, oak furniture; Nordic living room
